//: Kinds of message (15 §11), said with sound unless they name another signal. Strengths are in the units of the core sound kind, which an ordinary ear hears down to 0.001: a word said at 1 carries about thirty metres in the open, a shout at 8 to the edge of hearing.
name: report
doc: Telling someone what one saw: whom it is said to gains the memories and the track as told, believed at half the teller's confidence.

name: order
doc: An order (15 §10): obeyed by whoever holds a relation flagged `orders` toward whom it takes the giver for.

name: warning
doc: A warning, said loudly: stop, stay back.

name: call for help
doc: A shout for help: the watch answers it (`core:heed_help`).
